rules: Do not retain old mechanically explanatory about_*, why_*, or level concept/quiz/debrief copy in student view.
Render textbook_excerpt by ID only after attribution/licensing and failed-extraction checks; never improvise its content.
Render event fields as directly observed simulator state, not an unverified general protocol rule.
Do not allow a correctness score until after map evidence and one complete commit.
All labels/titles without overrides keep existing display strings unless a professor approves a new exact label.

app_copy_overrides.panel_edits: Changes you can make on the map
app_copy_overrides.panel_edits_hint: Select a device, port or cable to inspect it. Make changes on the map or use the equivalent controls in this panel.
app_copy_overrides.quiz_right: Your prediction matches the recorded events.
app_copy_overrides.quiz_wrong: Your prediction does not match the recorded events. Inspect the trace and try a new practice case.
app_copy_overrides.how_1: Select any device or cable to inspect it. The inspector records which evidence you used.
app_copy_overrides.how_2: Choose a packet to inspect its headers. Pause, step or replay its movement along the cables.
app_copy_overrides.how_3: Before a scored run, mark your predicted path and select the evidence supporting it.
app_copy_overrides.how_4: Edit devices or routes in the scene. Commit one complete plan, then inspect the outcome.
app_copy_overrides.how_5: After a run, compare your prediction with the event log. A new practice case is available if you need more work.

about_host.text: Select the computer to inspect its addresses and connected links.

about_printer.text: Select the printer to inspect its addresses and connected links.

about_server.text: Select the server to inspect its current connections and received requests.

why_nothing_lost.text: No frames were lost in this run. Compare the outcome with the mission objective before changing another device.

level_field_routes.title: data/verbatim_story_copy.json levels[id].title
level_field_routes.concept: refer to source IDs in data/textbook_source_manifest.json for the associated zone; never retain original concept literals
level_field_routes.quiz: remove existing answer-index question; replace with inspected scene-based precommit prediction and evidence requirements
level_field_routes.goal: keep solver-internal predicates, but neutralize student-visible answer-spoiling goal strings
level_field_routes.bonus: keep solver-internal predicate, suppress solution-bearing text before attempt

event_copy_policy.rule: Retain only event observations derived from live state. If a phrase makes a generalized mechanism claim, replace with registered excerpt slot; do not present a dynamic message as textbook quotation.
